messages.author: Ingrid Solberg
messages.text: Escalation: Android retention dropped for every install cohort from 2026-07-22 onwards. D1 ~36% -> ~30%, early D7 reads ~14% -> ~9.5%. Same drop in every channel and in Organic; iOS unchanged; CPI/CTR unchanged. Timing matches Android 2.14.0 (100% rollout evening of Jul 21). This is a product issue, not UA.

replies.author: Felix Brandt
replies.text: Confirmed from our side: the new asset-bundle loader in 2.14.0 adds ~9s to first load on low/mid-range Android devices and the new tutorial has a step where ~8% of users stall. We can't roll back because 2.14.0 also migrated the economy save format. Fix (2.15.0) is targeted for the first week of September.

replies.author: Marisol Okafor
replies.text: Thanks both. Decisions: (1) no Android bid cuts on the networks, it isn't their traffic, (2) we expect Android ROAS to soften as D7/D30 mature, finance please adjust the Q3 forecast, (3) Felix, please post in here when 2.15.0 ships.

replies.author: Chloe Nguyen
replies.text: Will rerun the Q3 forecast with lower Android D30.

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: And for the record, my 'traffic quality' theory from Monday was wrong. Glad we didn't cut bids.
